items.title: Why AMC Stock Is Jumping After a Big CEO Bust Up With Robinhood
items.summary: AMC’s Adam Aron criticized the online trading platform for its tokenized stocks and demanded that the company stop the trading of AMC stock tokens.  Robinhood stock fell 2.1%.  “What’s the concern?” Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev replied to Aron.
